dialogues.speaker: Gaston
dialogues.text: I traveled all the way here from Fontaine just to interview the owner of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Gaston
dialogues.text: I inquired about it everywhere, while people are constantly praising the architect who designed the place, no one knows who owns it.

dialogues.speaker: Gaston
dialogues.text: Isn't that an obvious scoop for me!?

dialogues.speaker: Gaston
dialogues.text: I may be just a trainee reporter from The Steambird, but I can't let that stop me. If I want to write an intriguing article, then I must be the first to eat the Specter!

dialogues.speaker: Gaston
dialogues.text: So, no matter how hard it is, I'm going to meet the owner of this place!
